visualization.help:
# vaRRI - Visual Annotation of RNA-RNA Interactions
This visualization embeds the complete, unmodified [vaRRI-js viewer](https://backofenlab.github.io/vaRRI-js/) in an iframe. It visualizes the base pairing of RNA-RNA interactions (RRIs) as 2D diagrams with additional annotation like coloring, region/subsequence highlights, point mutations, and probability profiles - see the upstream site for the full, always up-to-date list of settings and export options.
## Input
The dataset must be either:
- a JSON object of [vaRRI-js URL parameters](https://backofenlab.github.io/vaRRI-js/README.html#url-parameters--sharing), using upstream's own parameter names, forwarded through unchanged, e.g.:
```json { "sequence": "AACUCGCGAAAGCCAUAAAAACCAGGGAGACA&UUCCCUGGUGUUGGCGCAGUAUUCGCGCA", "structure": "....((((((.((((.....((((((((....&.))))))))..))))......))))))..", "startIndex1": -35, "startIndex2": 2, "coloring": "strand", "forceLayout": "1" } ```
- or a plain-text query string / full shareable URL, exactly as produced by vaRRI-js's own "🔗 Share Link" export button (simplest: use the input website to build your visualization, then save its Share Link output as the dataset).
## Features
Everything the upstream [vaRRI-js viewer](https://backofenlab.github.io/vaRRI-js/) supports, unmodified: settings panel, region/subsequence/point-mutation editors, probability profiles, zoom/pan, and SVG/PNG export.
Learn more at: [https://backofenlab.github.io/vaRRI-js/](https://backofenlab.github.io/vaRRI-js/)
